assertions.text: Response says Preflight step 1 runs python3 plugins/git-kit/scripts/git-review-scope.py and sends the full diff to $RUN/full.diff so its text stays out of context
Response says the 5 files form one batch, so there is one Codex Phase 1 dispatch and one Phase 2 dispatch (unchanged from before)
Response says no folder question is asked, because it fires only when dropped_slices is non-empty or the request names folders
Response says a planner exit of 2 sets PLAN_FAILED=1 without aborting the chain, is never treated as a pass, and the user chooses via AskUserQuestion between unscoped review and stop
